title: VP of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: EFI's market positioning emphasizes 'vibrant, high-resolution prints that are instantly cured, eco-friendly, and long-lasting—ideal for both indoor and outdoor signage.' Marketing owns this brand promise and competitive messaging, but currently lacks a protective film component to complete the durability story. This role is measured on market share growth, brand differentiation, and trade show ROI from their investments in ISA Sign Expo, FESPA Global Print Expo, and PRINTING United—all venues where protective film performance is a key customer concern. Tedlar's 60+ years of proven performance and extreme durability credentials (12-20+ year lifespan, no yellowing/fading) provide Marketing with third-party validation and case studies to strengthen EFI's 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' claims. The VP of Marketing would care about co-branding opportunities, joint customer success stories featuring complete print-to-protection workflows, and content marketing that positions EFI as the total solution provider rather than just an equipment vendor—directly supporting their premium market positioning against competitors.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As VP of Marketing at a $353M-$636M global equipment manufacturer, [Name] owns brand positioning, competitive differentiation messaging, and go-to-market strategy for EFI's wide-format printer and ink portfolios. This role drives market perception through trade show presence (ISA, FESPA, PRINTING United), customer education materials, and product launch messaging. [Name] likely reports to the Chief Revenue Officer or CEO and leads a team responsible for demand generation, content marketing, industry analyst relations, and customer success story development. They influence product positioning decisions and partner ecosystem messaging, working closely with Product Management and Sales to ensure market-facing materials support revenue goals.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: EFI's customers—sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, architectural graphics producers, and billboard companies—are the exact end-users who apply protective overlaminates to printed graphics. Tedlar's outdoor signage and graphics use case directly complements EFI's VUTEk and Pro series printers marketed for 'banners, billboards, building wraps, and outdoor applications.' The vehicle wrap and fleet graphics use case aligns with EFI's printer capabilities for fleet/vehicle graphics applications. Architectural graphics and building wraps match EFI's focus on building materials and superwide-format outdoor installations. Most critically, Tedlar enables [Name] to complete EFI's 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' narrative with a proven protective solution that extends the life of prints produced on EFI equipment—turning an equipment sale into a total durability solution story that differentiates EFI from HP, Canon, and other printer competitors who don't offer protective film guidance.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name]'s success metrics likely include market share growth in the outdoor signage segment, trade show lead quality and conversion rates, brand perception scores versus competitors, and sales enablement content effectiveness. A critical pain point: EFI markets 'durable Genuine EFI Inks' and 'long-lasting outdoor signage,' but when customers experience premature graphic failures due to inadequate protective films, it damages EFI's brand promise—even though the printer and ink performed correctly. [Name] needs proof points that validate EFI's durability claims beyond the print itself. Tedlar's UV resistance (no yellowing, fading, cracking over 12-20+ years) and graffiti resistance provide third-party validated performance data that Marketing can leverage in case studies, competitive battle cards, and trade show demonstrations. The reduced total cost of ownership message (fewer replacements, lower maintenance) strengthens EFI's premium pricing justification and helps [Name] demonstrate customer ROI, not just print quality.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: EFI just debuted the EFI Pro 30h+ hybrid printer at ISA Sign Expo 2025 and showcased multiple new LED inkjet printers at FESPA Global Print Expo 2025 (May 6-9, Berlin). These recent product launches create immediate opportunity for [Name] to refresh go-to-market materials and differentiation messaging. With CRO Todd Zimmerman publicly stating 'ISA Sign Expo is a staple show for our sign and display graphics customers,' EFI is actively investing in this market segment where protective film performance is a customer decision factor. The next PRINTING United Expo (September 2025) and ISA Sign Expo 2026 planning cycles are likely underway, making NOW the ideal time to explore co-marketing or solution bundling that [Name] can incorporate into booth messaging, demo workflows, and customer education materials. EFI's emphasis on outdoor applications in their current product positioning indicates strategic focus on exactly where Tedlar delivers the most value.

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI markets 'long-lasting outdoor signage' with their UV LED inks, but currently lacks a protective film recommendation to complete the durability promise customers expect
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as the missing piece in EFI's total solution narrative—position the conversation as helping [Name] strengthen EFI's outdoor durability messaging with third-party validated performance data that sales teams can use in customer conversations

personalization_hooks.hook: EFI exhibited at ISA Sign Expo 2025, FESPA 2025, and regularly at PRINTING United, where attendees actively compare complete print-to-protection workflows, not just equipment specs
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their trade show investments and suggest how co-marketing or demo integration could differentiate EFI's booth experience—offer to discuss joint customer success stories that showcase complete workflows from EFI printing to Tedlar protection

personalization_hooks.hook: VP of Marketing owns competitive differentiation against HP, Canon, and other printer manufacturers in a market where 'complete solution provider' positioning wins premium deals
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with competitive advantage angle—explain how recommending Tedlar enables EFI's sales team to offer customers a validated 12-20+ year outdoor performance guarantee that competitors can't match, turning equipment sales into strategic partnerships

recommended_approach: Lead with the competitive differentiation and brand promise angle. Open by acknowledging EFI's recent product launches and 'long-lasting outdoor graphics' positioning, then frame Tedlar as a strategic marketing asset that validates their durability claims with customer-facing proof points. Avoid leading with technical specs—focus instead on how this partnership strengthens [Name]'s go-to-market messaging and provides sales enablement content that differentiates EFI at their major trade show investments.
